rules: conditional branch lifecycle and explicit REF results
scope: A reference to a producer owned by a stopped switch child graph; capture designation once, then observe with an independent step.
expectation: The old target remains observable in its stop cycle and expires from the next engine cycle. A fresh instance of branch a never revives or retargets that captured designation.
inference: TS-23 states this timing for dictionary-child removal; the no-lifetime-extension rule and GRF-25 logical finalization imply the same for a stopped nested endpoint owner. The narrower wording must be clarified before a new HGL conformance assertion.
boundaries: Only capture a branch REF result published through its parent graph boundary. Do not directly access an endpoint inside a parallel graph. Raw observations/errors are retained independently of expected traces.

outer_owner_control.expectation: Both branch relays designate the surviving outer input. Stopping a relay must not expire its upstream endpoint or prevent continued following.
